inbox_get.description: Internal owner/web body view by exact persisted mailbox and canonical message id. Does not mark read, acknowledge or notify. Agent-only mail requires explicit include_agent=true. One metadata-only audit line per lookup.

params.description: Exact persisted mailbox key (not a live target label).
Canonical inbox id, for example i42.
Explicit opt-in for agent-only mail; default false.

Whose inbox: an agent name, a pane id, a unique label substring, or 'self' for your own. Agent names are preferred because they survive a pane moving or restarting. A name that matches no live pane still works, so mail can be left for an agent that is not running.
Only unread messages (default true).
How many to return (default 50).
Newest-first summaries with audience and next_before; default false.
Exclusive next_before message ID; requires newest_first.
Owner/web/system: stored mailbox key, without label lookup; requires newest_first.
With newest_first: include/exclude agent-only rows before paging. Omit for legacy.

inbox_read.description: Read waiting messages in order, with their full bodies, and mark them read. Task queues are omitted by default; set include_tasks=true to include them. This is the one an agent calls when it has mail. Use peek=true to look without marking them read. If the answer never arrives, inbox_recover replays the batch instead of losing it.

params.description: Whose inbox: an agent name, a pane id, a unique label substring, or 'self' for your own. Agent names are preferred because they survive a pane moving or restarting. A name that matches no live pane still works, so mail can be left for an agent that is not running.
How many to read (default 10).
Do not mark them read (default false).
Include the caller's task queues in the result (default false).

inbox.description: Agent-to-agent mailbox. action=send or send_agent_only (preferred over typing), count, list, read (add include_tasks=true to include task queues), recover, status, ack, cancel, delete, stats, fetch. No size limit; a send nudges the recipient with one line. The owner's mailbox (FLAT_FLEET.md 7.2) is read with action=conversation, answered with action=reply, which keeps the question's transport and links the answer to it, and fed by a bridge with action=ingest (transport + external_id), drained with action=outbox and confirmed with action=delivered (desk and owner only).
